why: Today's lead tooling for next/ L11: prepared independent fixed mappings, tea phase machine, private trace and report validation, ten-slot collection, and multiple-file restoration through memory stand-ins. Ten unit laws pass; ten deliberate unit breaks were assertion-red and restored. Format and all 18 lint parts pass. Final adapter, CLI and workflow integration awaits tracker 1133 landing. No compiler, runtime adapter, protected law, CI dispatch, output exercise or timing measurement ran. No reliability or product proof is claimed.

plants.law: strict requests reject caller additions and every unsupported case or source
fixed edits reject missing or duplicate anchors and preserve every other byte
fixed source and transform hashes refuse every changed input before writing
plants.plant: Omit the original source digest check

plants.law: report reconciliation refuses missing, skipped, contradictory and wrong-name assertions
plants.plant: Accept a missing exact assertion name

plants.law: private input equality compares complete ordered values and every changed point
plants.plant: Accept any two individually complete traces

plants.law: ten declared slots retain the first failure and reject replacement attempts
plants.plant: Drop every failed or unstarted slot

plants.law: [secrets] sanitized facts discard raw diagnostics, generated values and paths
plants.plant: Copy the raw reporter into the published observation

plants.law: multiple-file restoration attempts every saved file after each injected I/O failure
plants.plant: Restore only the first saved file

plants.law: case-specific phase walks preserve timing failures and require plant restoration
plants.plant: Skip the restored clean test phase

plants.law: a plant timeout cannot complete while a measurement timeout remains an observation
plants.plant: Accept a timing failure as an output leak
